latestHardenedPolicyAttempt.correctionState: configuration corrected locally; corrected network rerun blocked by network quota

currentProductionSpotcheck.scope: Playwright spot-check of the deployed public root, /home/, /page/2/, /newsletter/, and /ai-certifications/ plus root response headers and console.
currentProductionSpotcheck.observed: The deployed production bytes still expose the pre-remediation defects, including Blog at root, broken repeated pagination, raw MailPoet shortcodes, HTTP YouTube, PHP/8.1.34 disclosure, and wp is not defined.

statusDefinitions.historical_staging_mechanical_evidence: A mechanical behavior passed on staging version 1.4.0, but no current 1.4.1 staging or production proof exists.
statusDefinitions.historical_staging_containment_evidence: Risky material was hidden, drafted, or tombstoned on staging version 1.4.0; the underlying claim was not substantively corrected.
statusDefinitions.partial: A bounded local or historical staging control exists, but one or more material acceptance gates remain.
statusDefinitions.human_or_legal_gate: Automation supplied an inventory or fail-closed control, but accountable human, operator, editorial, or legal approval is still required.
statusDefinitions.open_runtime: The core runtime condition remains present on the deployed environment.

findings.title: The root and real homepage are split across two indexable URLs
progress: Historical staging v1.4.0 served the branded page at /, the native archive at /blog/, and a one-hop permanent redirect from /home/.
The retained v1.4.0 browser crawl passed the root, Home, Blog, canonical, and sitemap assertions.
remainingGates: Deploy the hash-verified v1.4.1 candidate to isolated staging and pass the corrected no-skip route/canonical/sitemap/browser crawl plus web-SAPI smoke and log review.
Deploy through an approved production manifest and retain equivalent production routing evidence.

findings.title: Blog pagination is broken and repeats page one
progress: Historical staging v1.4.0 exposed 65 sitemap posts through /blog/ pagination with no missing post in the retained pager assertion.
Legacy /page/N/ requests redirected to the corresponding /blog/page/N/ route in that historical candidate.
remainingGates: Repeat complete pagination, differentiated metadata, self-canonical, and post-coverage proof after v1.4.1 is deployed to staging.
Repeat the same proof after approved production deployment.

findings.title: Eight demo records are indexed as real people, testimonials, and cases
progress: Historical staging v1.4.0 returned exact 410 responses for the eight demo records and excluded the corresponding records from discovery surfaces.
The hardened v1.4.0 attempt observed all 12 configured gone routes at 410, including the eight demo routes, even though the overall route-policy check failed for a different classification error.
remainingGates: Deploy v1.4.1 and pass exact route, feed, sitemap, query, link, and preserved-record tests using the corrected policy configuration.
Apply the same reversible tombstones in production and retain live evidence; do not imply any testimonial or identity was substantiated.

findings.title: The newsletter conversion system is visibly broken
progress: Historical staging v1.4.0 removed raw MailPoet tokens and used an email-only update-request fallback; it did not prove a subscription workflow.
Local v1.4.1 instead proposes reversible 410 tombstones for both newsletter routes and permanently disables collection forms, but those bytes are undeployed and untested on staging.
remainingGates: An accountable owner must choose either a retired newsletter or a real provider-backed subscribe, confirmation, delivery, unsubscribe, consent, privacy, and cadence workflow.
After that decision, rebuild if required, deploy, and test v1.4.1 or its approved successor on staging and then production.

findings.title: High-stakes career guidance contains mislabeled, retired, or unsupported credentials
progress: The certifications page was draft/non-public on historical staging and returned 404 in the hardened v1.4.0 observation.
Local v1.4.1 proposes an exact reversible 410 tombstone; no credential content was corrected or issuer-verified.
remainingGates: Keep the route retired or rebuild it from current primary issuer sources with exact credential names, codes, status, prerequisites, fees, renewal, role fit, method, and verified-on date under accountable review.
Pass current-candidate staging and production containment or publication tests.

findings.title: Foundational AI explainers contain basic factual errors
progress: The GPT Models post was draft/non-public on historical staging and returned 404 in the hardened v1.4.0 observation.
Local v1.4.1 proposes an exact reversible 410 tombstone; the known errors and full article remain uncorrected.
remainingGates: Keep the route retired or complete a primary-source technical rewrite and named technical review covering the full article, not only the four known defects.
Pass current-candidate staging and production containment or publication tests.

findings.title: The Grok article appears to invent or conflate a business platform
progress: The GrokAI post was draft/non-public on historical staging and returned 404 in the hardened v1.4.0 observation.
Local v1.4.1 proposes an exact reversible 410 tombstone; no vendor identity or enterprise capability was verified.
remainingGates: Keep the route retired or identify the real product and rewrite from dated primary product, pricing, security, and support evidence under accountable review.
Pass current-candidate staging and production containment or publication tests.

findings.title: There is no accountable author behind 71 posts
progress: The new 71-post inventory records a missing visible author signal for all 71 frozen audit posts and supplies per-post review queues without assigning authorship.

Local v1.4.1 removes the earlier unattested sitewide Vijay authorship/editorial-responsibility statement, renders dates without inventing a byline, and proposes structural-only schema filtering; it is undeployed.
remainingGates: The legal operator must attest author or editorial responsibility page by page, and every named person must approve a qualification-specific profile.
Approve and publish truthful sourcing, correction, AI-use, conflict, affiliate, reviewer, and publisher policies; then deploy and validate corresponding visible and schema output.

findings.title: Public runtime is obsolete and version details are exposed
progress: Under a hash-verified official PHP 8.4.24 CLI, all seven current v1.4.1 source/test PHP files passed syntax lint, the policy fixture passed 29/29, and the schema/author fixture passed 36/36.
The ZIP SHA-256 candidate extracted all 8 expected runtime files, matched all 8 settled-source files, and all 5 packaged PHP files passed lint.

The final current-source Graphify refresh records 257 nodes and 389 edges with zero missing, dangling, self-loop, duplicate, or collapsed edges; the deployed staging runtime still historically reported PHP 8.1.34 and no current v1.4.1 web-SAPI or log proof exists.
remainingGates: Deploy the verified v1.4.1 candidate to isolated staging on a supported PHP patch, prove extension parity and WordPress/theme/plugin interoperability, resolve Sirat Pro provenance, and retain clean web/runtime logs.
Remove disclosure origin-wide, prove package integrity and web compatibility, then repeat on production after approved deployment.

findings.title: Internal links contain two 404s and sitewide redirect waste
progress: The historical v1.4.0 crawl tested 110 internal destinations derived from 76 source pages and found no broken, redirecting, unobserved, or directly noncanonical targets.
Local v1.4.1 additionally proposes unlinking every exact tombstoned path, but the changed link surface has no new staging crawl.
remainingGates: Run the complete link-integrity gate against deployed v1.4.1 with all changed tombstones and sitemap URLs.
Repeat after production deployment and retain a future editorial broken-link gate.

findings.title: Mobile payloads are excessive
progress: Historical staging v1.4.0 passed the retained 390x844 transfer and DOM budgets on four sampled routes; the largest tested transfer was below 0.9 MB and images below 0.42 MB.
Responsive image markup patches are hash-addressed locally, but the result is a bounded lab sample and predates v1.4.1.
remainingGates: Complete controlled AVIF/WebP conversion, visual diffs, identified-LCP work, and cold/warm mobile Lighthouse on the final staging candidate.
After production deployment, retain production Lighthouse plus Search Console or CrUX field evidence.

findings.title: Metadata control is poor across the entire indexable inventory
progress: The historical v1.4.0 crawl found no missing or overlong titles/descriptions and complete Open Graph/Twitter field sets across 75 staging sitemap URLs.
Local v1.4.1 materially changes the public/tombstoned inventory, so the historical 75-URL result cannot certify its current metadata surface.
remainingGates: Deploy v1.4.1 and rerun complete sitemap, canonical, uniqueness, length, tag-count, and social-field tests on the resulting inventory.
Repeat on production and keep future editorial metadata gates active.

findings.title: Headings and thin hubs fail page intent
progress: Historical staging v1.4.0 found no missing, multiple, blank, or skipped heading levels across 75 sitemap URLs and suppressed several empty or unsupported hubs.
The 71-post inventory now supplies machine-draft retain, update, merge, retire, or review recommendations; none is human approval.
remainingGates: An accountable editor must decide whether every surviving thin page satisfies a distinct user intent and then enrich, merge, or retire it.
Rerun heading and content-intent gates on deployed v1.4.1 and on production.

findings.title: Front-end errors and broken components occur sitewide
progress: The historical v1.4.0 crawl found no known placeholder leak across 75 sitemap pages and no exceptions, console/log errors, network failures, WAF blocks, or overflow on four rendered routes.
The local v1.4.1 candidate changes routing, collection, schema, links, and output copy; no post-change browser run exists.
remainingGates: Run a browser-required, cache-bypassed, no-skip crawl after deploying v1.4.1, including representative interactive routes and all known component signatures.
Repeat on production with monitoring and server-log review.

findings.title: Brand and audience are incoherent
progress: Historical staging suppressed or drafted several unsupported child, course, service, and enterprise propositions.
Local v1.4.1 proposes broader reversible tombstones, reducing exposure without choosing a brand strategy.
remainingGates: The executive/product owner must approve one primary audience, promise, commercial model, allowed brand vocabulary, off-domain boundaries, and an accountable owner for each remaining journey.
Implement the decision in navigation, content, metadata, and schema, then validate staging and production.

findings.title: Children's content makes unsupported safety promises
progress: Historical staging drafted /ai-tools-for-kids/ and returned 410 for the exact /services/ai-for-kids/ route.
The hardened v1.4.0 attempt observed the drafted page at 404, and local v1.4.1 proposes exact 410 tombstones for both routes.
remainingGates: Pass corrected v1.4.1 route, discovery, feed, sitemap, and link containment tests.
Do not republish without documented age/supervision, privacy, advertising, moderation, accessibility, learning-goal, parent/educator, and child/privacy legal review; repeat proof on production.

findings.title: Affiliate-style book recommendations lack disclosure and method
progress: Historical staging drafted /ai-books-for-kids/, and the hardened v1.4.0 attempt observed the route at 404.
Local v1.4.1 proposes an exact reversible 410 tombstone; compensation status and recommendation quality remain unreviewed.
remainingGates: Pass corrected v1.4.1 containment tests on staging and production.
Do not republish until compensation is determined and prominently disclosed, exact editions/ISBNs and age method are documented, and an accountable editor approves selection evidence and limitations.

findings.title: About, mission, and service claims lack evidence
progress: Historical staging used bounded About copy and suppressed unsupported service and footer claims.
Local v1.4.1 further removes unattested founder/editor responsibility language and proposes structural-only schema, but it is undeployed.
remainingGates: The operator must substantiate legal publisher identity, qualifications, methods, metrics, events, customers, services, and curricula before any such claim returns.
Deploy and validate the approved bounded copy and schema on current staging and production.

findings.title: Privacy copy does not match site activities
progress: Historical staging suppressed optional measurement/chatbot/form collection and kept the legacy privacy route noindex and out of the sitemap.
Local v1.4.1 permanently disables collection forms and proposes retiring newsletter routes, but no legal privacy notice has been approved and the candidate is undeployed.
remainingGates: The legal operator and privacy reviewer must approve the actual controller, vendors, cookies/analytics, collection, children, affiliates, retention, rights, security, and collection-point notices.
Validate real data flows against the notice before staging and production publication.

findings.title: Content and archive clusters overlap without an intent map
progress: Historical staging noindexed archive/search surfaces, excluded categories from XML sitemaps, and passed Blog canonical pagination.

The new machine-draft inventory maps 71 posts into 7 topic clusters and 59 canonical intents, flags 21 probable-overlap posts, and explicitly leaves one staging aggregate reconciliation delta unresolved.
The regression configuration now bans every /category/ path class, but the corrected live rerun was blocked by network quota.
remainingGates: Retain the exact final staging sitemap URL list, reconcile the unexplained one-post delta, and obtain human/search-data approval for one canonical page per job and all merge/redirect decisions.
Pass the corrected all-category/current-candidate crawl and then repeat on production with Search Console evidence.

findings.title: Roadmap, test, and benchmark headlines do not deliver reproducible artifacts
progress: Historical staging drafted four unfulfilled technical-artifact posts and the benchmark page; retained pre-change records support rollback and review.

The hardened v1.4.0 attempt observed the four newly enumerated post routes at 404 and the benchmark route at 404, although the benchmark was misclassified in that failed run; local v1.4.1 proposes exact 410 tombstones for all five.
remainingGates: Deploy v1.4.1 and pass the corrected exact 410/discovery/link/feed/sitemap contract for all five routes.
Keep retired or publish only after the promised repository, fixtures, data, versions, method, limitations, and reproducible result are independently checked; repeat on production.

findings.title: Social cards are incomplete
progress: Historical staging v1.4.0 emitted complete Open Graph and Twitter field sets, using a small logo fallback where page media was absent.

A generated local review candidate now exists at 1200x630, preserves the supplied logo, and passes dimension requirements; it remains non-approvable pending brand signoff plus Facebook/LinkedIn/X preview proof, and is not wired into WordPress.
remainingGates: Create and approve an exact 1200x630 branded asset system that preserves the mark, then validate crops, readability, file properties, and Facebook, LinkedIn, and X previews.
Wire only the approved asset, deploy the current candidate, and rerun staging and production social-image resource checks.

findings.title: Image alt text requires a human relevance review
progress: The complete inventory records 974 images and 184 empty-alt instances across 77 pages.
Exactly two machine-safe source-less carousel images, ALT-162 and ALT-163, now have deterministic remove decisions; 182 image-purpose decisions remain human-owned.
remainingGates: A human must inspect pixels, adjacent content, and link purpose and record an approved decorative, informative, functional, or remove disposition for the remaining 182 instances.
Implement 184/184 decisions, recapture the candidate, run screen-reader and control checks, and repeat validation on production.

findings.title: Schema is syntactically healthy but semantically uneven
progress: Historical staging v1.4.0 had parseable JSON-LD on 75 sitemap pages and removed selected unverified homepage entities.

Local v1.4.1 proposes globally retaining only structural WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList, ListItem, and ImageObject types until claims are approved; its source and packaged PHP lint pass, and the schema/author fixture passes 36/36, but the filter is undeployed and lacks current staging/browser proof.
remainingGates: Deploy and crawl the verified v1.4.1 schema filter on isolated staging, proving valid relationships, web-SAPI behavior, and no accidental loss of required structural data.
Obtain human-attested publisher/person/article decisions and external Schema Markup Validator or Rich Results evidence before restoring claim-bearing entities; repeat on production.

findings.title: Mixed-scheme references remain
progress: The historical v1.4.0 crawl found zero HTTP references across all 75 staging sitemap pages and normalized known same-site schema/content/footer targets.
No equivalent crawl exists for the changed v1.4.1 public inventory or for production.
remainingGates: Run complete HTML, JSON-LD, CSS/resource, and redirect mixed-scheme checks on deployed v1.4.1.
Repeat the same checks on production and retain the gate for future publishing.

findings.title: Mobile has no basic horizontal overflow, but controls are weak
progress: Direct historical staging checks at 390x844 recorded named 44x44 carousel dots, one current state, hidden clones, menu/search keyboard and Escape behavior, focus return, paused autoplay while focused, and no horizontal overflow.
The retained full-crawl JSON proves general browser health but does not retain a control-level accessibility result, and the local v1.4.1 candidate has no new browser run.
remainingGates: Retain structured machine-readable control-level evidence for names, roles, states, keyboard paths, focus, clone hiding, target size/spacing, reduced motion, and overflow on the current staging candidate.
Complete screen-reader/editorial sampling and M2 decisions, then repeat the evidence on production.

findings.title: Response hardening and caching headers are weak
progress: Historical staging v1.4.0 passed required security/cache header assertions on 75 canonical HTML pages.
A fail-closed origin .htaccess package and manifest now exist with CSP report-only, but their status is dormant-not-deployed and productionAuthorized is false.
remainingGates: Deploy the origin policy only through an approved staging insertion/rollback procedure and test anonymous/authenticated HTML, REST, login, admin redirect, error, sitemap, CSS, image, and private-cache behavior.
Review CSP reports before enforcement, remove PHP disclosure host-wide, then repeat the full matrix on production.

findings.title: Formulaic AI content language weakens authority
progress: The 71-post machine inventory flags formulaic body-language signals on 63 posts and formulaic title-language signals on 19 posts, with exact phrase baselines.
No synonym rewrite or claim of AI authorship was made; the inventory is a triage queue, not editorial approval.
remainingGates: An accountable editor must rewrite, substantively improve, merge, or retire priority articles based on evidence, distinct reader value, and site scope.
Approve and enforce a pre-publication style/evidence standard, then validate the surviving staging and production corpus.

findings.title: Grammar and production defects are recurrent
progress: Historical staging v1.4.0 removed the known deterministic tokens and defects from the clean 75-page crawl, including Linkden, Service Url, raw shortcode, bad email scheme, stale copyright, and captured placeholder strings.
The surviving corpus has not received a complete human line edit, and local v1.4.1 changes output copy without a new staging crawl.
remainingGates: Complete accountable line editing of every retained page and adopt a mandatory pre-publication production checklist.
Rerun deterministic pattern and rendered checks on deployed v1.4.1 and production.

findings.title: Taxonomy has no visible editorial strategy
progress: Historical staging noindexed category/archive/search surfaces and excluded category taxonomies from XML sitemaps.
The current regression configuration prohibits every /category/ path class rather than only /category/blog/, but the corrected network rerun was blocked by quota.
The 71-post inventory supplies 7 machine-draft topic clusters; it is not an approved taxonomy.
remainingGates: Pass the corrected all-category sitemap, indexability, canonical, and discovery checks on deployed v1.4.1.
Obtain human approval for taxonomy names, archive introductions, merge strategy, and user journeys, then repeat on production.

findings.title: Contact conversion asks for data without explaining the exchange
progress: Historical staging v1.4.0 minimized collection to an explicit email path, removed phone/file inputs, warned against sensitive submissions, and linked a pending privacy route.
Local v1.4.1 hard-disables collection forms and keeps an email-only fallback, but it is undeployed and still cannot establish retention, response, or legally approved privacy expectations.
remainingGates: The accountable operator/privacy reviewer must approve the collection purpose, data handling, retention/deletion, response expectation, security boundary, and collection-point notice.
Test the complete exchange and privacy context on current staging, then deploy and repeat on production.

findings.title: Publication freshness is weak for a fast-moving AI site
progress: The new inventory covers all 71 frozen audit posts, flags 70 as stale over 365 days, and creates machine-draft freshness priorities of 12 critical, 32 high, and 27 medium.
Its 71 recommendations and due dates are explicitly unapproved; seven exact known drafts do not reconcile the retained 65-post staging aggregate, leaving one unexplained delta.
remainingGates: Assign a named owner and approve a retain, update, merge, retire, or specialist-review disposition for all 71 posts, with primary-source review and truthful reviewed-on/correction records.
Resolve the one-post staging reconciliation delta, approve a sustainable cadence, implement decisions, and validate staging and production without treating timestamp changes as review.
